note: Typical premium-cabin products by airline and aircraft, compiled from airline information and reviews (The Points Guy, One Mile at a Time, Upgraded Points and others). Many fleets are mixed: when certainty is 'varies' the product depends on the specific aircraft — check the seat map. Score: 5 = top-tier private suite (usually with a door), 4 = excellent lie-flat with direct aisle access, 3 = good lie-flat, 2 = older lie-flat/angled or no aisle access for all, 1 = recliner. Corrections: edit this file on main; installed apps refresh it automatically.
